how to slow internet

how to slow internet is an artist project centrally focused on experimentation with small scale communication technology in order to better consider the large scale communications infrastructure on which we increasingly depend.

📡 Subscribe to RSS feed to get research and open call updates.

📋 A guide to the guides 💯

We have put together a guide to the guides below after relying on these resources to build this project. Within these guides you will both practical information and inspiration. If you run into terms you are not familiar with, check our slow glossary!

Why a Low-Tech Website?

"We were told that the Internet would “dematerialise” society and decrease energy use. Contrary to this projection, it has become a large and rapidly growing consumer of energy itself."

Towards a Natural Intelligence

"The Solar Protocol network reconfigures internet protocols using a kind of natural rather than artificial intelligence."

Solar Powered Media

"Without guaranteed 24/7 electricity from fossil fuels, solar invites questions of intermittency, thrift, and compression." by Anne Pasek & Benedetta Piantella
